name: Aggregate UVs
explanation_long: UVs and textures are aggregated from different materials into a single atlas when possible, by appending the original UVs side-by-side. Transparent parts are processed separately.

exposed_options.name: Allow Rectangular Atlas
exposed_options.description: Generates rectangular powers-of-two textures when beneficial for auto-sized textures.
exposed_options.description_long: Generates rectangular powers-of-two textures when beneficial for auto-sized textures. This can reduce waste of empty areas in textures, which helps improve file sizes and texture memory usage.

exposed_options.name: Re-bake normal maps
exposed_options.description: Re-bakes normal maps when preserving UVs, even if UV overlaps are detected.
